subject: Offer packet for Samir Khan — routing, start date, and DocuSign
messages:
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@gmail.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@talentsol.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Offer packet for Samir Khan — first draft and scheduling

Hi team,

Attached is the first draft of Samir's offer packet (base comp, equity summary, benefits). I flagged two things for quick input:

- Proposed start date: Jan 4, 2027 (Samir indicated flexibility but prefers early Jan)
- Equity cliff: candidate asked if the standard 1-year cliff can be adjusted to a 3-month cliff in the first year (we can offer an acceleration if necessary)

Samir is available for a 20-min call tomorrow at 10:30am PST to walk through the package. Can the hiring manager (Lauren) join, and can Karthik approve the final comp wording before we send to DocuSign? Vivek, if we need sign-off for any variance from standard equity language I can route to you.

Attachments: Offer_SamirKhan_v1.pdf

Thanks — I can update the PDF with any redlines from legal and re-upload.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0176

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Samir Khan <samir.khan@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer packet for Samir Khan — first draft and scheduling

Thanks Tessa — I can be on the call tomorrow at 10:30am PST. Lauren, can you join as well?

On the equity cliff request: my preference is to keep the 1-year cliff but offer a signing bonus if the candidate needs earlier liquidity. If Legal is comfortable, we can also agree to a partial acceleration tied to a 3-month milestone.

Tessa, please route the current PDF to Legal for a quick read on the redline (I'll need the final comp line item and equity grant ID before I approve for DocuSign). If Legal requests changes, please send both a redlined docx and a clean PDF.

Karthik Iyer
Staff SRE Recruiter (on hiring ops) | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@gmail.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer packet for Samir Khan — first draft and scheduling

Hi Tessa / Karthik / Lauren,

Thanks for the draft — I appreciate the clear summary. I can do the 10:30am PST call tomorrow to discuss. A couple quick notes before the call so we can use time efficiently: 

1) Start date: Jan 4 sounds great. I would, however, like the ability to adjust to Jan 18 if my visa paperwork takes longer. Is that acceptable?
2) Equity cliff: I was hoping to request the 3-month cliff because I have previous RSU vesting that impacts tax timing. If we can't change the cliff I'm open to the signing bonus idea — could you indicate the typical range?

I also attached a short redline with a single suggested change to the vacation accrual language (minor wording). I don't expect anything major.

Attached: Offer_SamirKhan_v1_redline.docx

Looking forward to speaking tomorrow.

—Samir
samir.khan@gmail.com | +1 (650) 555-0119

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Samir Khan <samir.khan@gmail.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer packet for Samir Khan — first draft and scheduling

Thanks — I can join the 10:30am call. My notes in advance:

- Start date: OK to leave Jan 4 as proposed but include explicit language allowing candidate to delay up to 2 weeks for visa/admin reasons (so Jan 18 max).
- Signing bonus: we typically offer $10k–$15k for situations like this; prefer $12k if compensation budget allows.
- Equity cliff: prefer to keep 1-year standard; offering partial acceleration to cover the first 3 months is acceptable (accelerate 25% at 3 months).

Vivek — can you confirm you authorize a $12k signing bonus if we decide to go that route? If yes, Tessa can reflect that in the DocuSign packet and I'll be comfortable approving.

Lauren Bishop
Hiring Manager, Inference Team | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Offer packet for Samir Khan — first draft and scheduling

Approved. Lauren, you have my sign-off to include a $12,000 signing bonus and the 25% 3-month acceleration schedule. Tessa, please:

1) Update the offer PDF to include the alternate start-date window (Jan 4 or up to Jan 18) and the signing bonus line item.
2) Generate a clean PDF and a redlined docx reflecting the 25% acceleration and the vacation wording Samir suggested.
3) Send final package via DocuSign with the auditing envelope set to: karthik_iyer, lauren_bishop, vivek_kulkarni (approvers) and Samir as signatory.

Once DocuSign is out, please share the link and Greenhouse stage update so I can route the approval internally.

Thanks — and Samir, excited to have you join.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
